blocked.name: Natural Habitat of Pyrus calleryana (Inunashi/Mamenashi) in Tado
blocked.why: National Natural Monument designated 2010-08-05: a grove/population of 46 mature Pyrus calleryana var. dimorphophylla trees plus numerous seedlings, spread across roughly 3,000 sq m (170m by 30m) on Tado-yama near Midori-ike pond, Kuwana City, Mie Prefecture. An area/habitat conservation designation for a wild population, not a single named specimen or a compact ensemble with one obvious place to stand; fails the collectible-point test the way an avenue or a whole wood does. About 21.7 km from Nagoya, which would put it outside the day-trip cluster in any case. Sources: ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/多度のイヌナシ自生地, bunka.nii.ac.jp/heritages/detail/199562.
